anomalies.observed: On the root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch) the NFC_IC hierarchical-sheet pins NFC_INT/NFC_SCL/NFC_SDA run to U2 pins 22 (PA6), 23 (PA7) and 41 (PA8). U2 pins 61 (PB8) and 62 (PB9) have no wires attached.
anomalies.expected: The specification places the NFC I2C bus on U2 pin 61 (PB8) for NFC_SCL and U2 pin 62 (PB9) for NFC_SDA.

evidence.quote: NFC_SDA net: U2 pin 62 (PB9) — R1 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 5 (SDA)
NFC_SCL net: U2 pin 61 (PB8) — R2 (10 kΩ) to VCC — U3 pin 3 (SCL)
Root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch): the NFC_IC block's NFC_INT/NFC_SCL/NFC_SDA pins are wired left into U2's PA6/PA7/PA8 pins; PB8(61)/PB9(62) are drawn unconnected.

anomalies.impact: The NT3H2111 tag IC would not sit on the MCU pins the firmware expects for I2C1 (PB8/PB9); NFC tap/field-detect would not work even though the rest of the board powers up.

anomalies.observed: U2's bottom supply row (pins 18, 63, 47, 31, 12, 13) is joined into one net that is returned to the GND symbol, so pin 13 (VDDA) sits on the GND rail along with the VSS/VSSA pins.
anomalies.expected: VDDA (pin 13) is the analog supply and must be connected to the positive VCC rail (per standard STM32 practice / the part's function), not to GND.

evidence.quote: Root sheet (PCB.kicad_sch): U2 bottom pins 18/63/47/31/12/13 are tied together by a single net that drops to the GND symbol below the MCU.

anomalies.impact: Grounding the analog supply pin would keep the MCU's analog domain (and potentially the PLL/reset circuitry) off, so the board would not run correctly.

parsed.summary: The board is largely the specified Portal design (component values, BS strapping, VBAT/VOUT rails and charge-pump network all match), but the NFC I2C pair appears routed to PA7/PA8 instead of the specified PB8/PB9, and there is also a suspicion that U2's VDDA pin is tied to GND; either would make the board behave differently from the intended design.
